1.consolidated_definition: Planta ornamental trepadora de bejucos fibrosos de color verde monte, de hojas grandes y ovaladas, con el borde dentado. Hay cierta variedad en Puerto Rico, según el color de sus florecillas lilas o rojas.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Vine climbing ornamental plant with fibrous stems of green mountain color, having large and oval-shaped leaves with toothed edges. There is a certain variety in Puerto Rico, according to the color of its lilac or red flowers.
